title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
requirement: Housing providers receiving DND funding or land, or with BPDA income-restricted units, may not blanket-deny applicants with arrests or convictions; they must screen case-by-case, disregard non-convictions, sealed, expunged and juvenile records and convictions over 5 years old, and not use credit scores.
coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.

conditions.text: Housing providers receiving DND funding or land, or with income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy

applicability.per_tenancy: Does not apply where there is a direct relationship between the conviction and the housing sought or an unreasonable risk of substantial harm, or to current criminal behavior.
coverage_quotes: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions.

exemptions: Where there is a direct relationship between a conviction and the housing sought or an unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others; current criminal behavior.
citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
quoted_span: will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on a case-by-case basis.
interaction: Yields to federal or state criminal history requirements that conflict with this policy.
conflict_note: The policy states that where federal or state law imposes a conflicting criminal history requirement, that law preempts this policy.
